headline: Visa's AI shopping benchmark reported 42.8% of test runs did not pass
body: In Visa's benchmark, 57.2% of test runs passed when 22 AI models from 12 labs went through realistic shopping scenarios. The best-performing models passed 82.2% of runs, while the worst-performing passed 28.9%, according to the release.
note: For payments firms, the gap between the best and worst models is the detail to watch. The benchmark is designed to create a roadmap for industry players, and the release says consumers can also use the test.

evidence.text: Visa found that when 22 artificial intelligence models from 12 labs were put through realistic shopping scenarios, 57.2% of the test runs passed and 42.8% failed, according to a Thursday (Nov. 5) press release.
Among the best-performing AI models, 82.2% of test runs passed, while among the worst-performing models, 28.9% of test runs passed, the release said.

These are some of the findings of Visa’s new industry benchmark for AI shopping, Visa Agentic Commerce Benchmark , which is designed to create a roadmap for industry players to deliver better agentic shopping experiences.
The test can also be used by consumers, the release said.
